title: Urinary microRNA Profiles Distinguishing Prostate Cancer from Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia: An Exploratory Two-Cohort Small-RNA Sequencing Study.
snippet: Urinary microRNAs (miRNAs) are candidate non-invasive markers for distinguishing prostate cancer (PCa) from benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), but differences found in a single cohort often fail to recur in another.
